description.narrative: The MASC Foundation developed and approved a Strategic Plan for 2020-2030, which is centred on democratization and advancing more inclusive social justice, shifting its priority to Governance Advocacy and the promotion of joint CSO Action. MASC has always advocated a holistic, integrated, collaborative, learning, flexible, adaptive, politically informed and community-orientated approach to its work. For this project, the intervention will be a combination of grants and capacity building for CSOs, direct implementation by MASC using its Savings Groups, Village Development Organisations, and Ambassadors for Peace and strategic partners founded on the principle that communities can take ownership of their own development and respective peace and social cohesion. (Community savings and credit groups and active village development organisation – VDOs and other formal and informal grassroots organisations).
